sections.label: Revnyx SDK
sections.description: SDK deployed on Asianet's infrastructure. Monitors real-time signal ingestion from internal systems.

connectors.name: Billing & Subscriber System
connectors.description: SDK listener on BSS — captures payment failure events, plan changes, and billing cycle completions in real time

connectors.name: Network & Provisioning System
connectors.description: SDK listener on OSS — captures usage drop signals, service quality events, and device activity changes

connectors.name: Product Analytics Layer
connectors.description: SDK webhook bridge — fires on no-login triggers, feature drop-off, and custom churn signals from Asianet's product layer

sections.label: CRM Integration
sections.description: Two-way sync with Asianet's CRM — Revnyx reads customer context and writes intervention outcomes back.

connectors.name: Asianet CRM
connectors.description: Pulls subscriber profiles, contact details, lifetime value, and churn scores. Revnyx writes every intervention outcome back automatically.

sections.label: Channel APIs
sections.description: Outbound execution pipes — Revnyx triggers interventions through these APIs when a workflow fires.

connectors.name: WhatsApp Business API
connectors.description: Asianet's verified WhatsApp Business account — used for sending intervention messages, payment links, and recovery offers

connectors.name: SMS Gateway
connectors.description: SMS delivery for short-form trigger messages, payment links, and callback prompts

connectors.name: Email Service
connectors.description: Transactional email delivery for intervention templates with personalisation tokens and open/click tracking

connectors.name: Voice AI Engine
connectors.description: Revnyx's LLM-powered voice agent — handles outbound and inbound calls with STT + TTS and outcome capture
